subject: Dynamic Occupancy Models when False Positives occur (colext + occuFP)

messages.author: aadb02e4fe810b70
messages.subject: Dynamic Occupancy Models when False Positives occur (colext + occuFP)
parts:
Hello all,

Does unmarked contain streamlined functionality for fitting dynamic occupancy models when false positives occur (a la Miller et al. 2013, models for which were fit in PRESENCE)? I.e., is there an existing modification that unifies the main ideas of colext() & occuFP()? Apologies if I have overlooked this material in the package's documentation.

If not, I'll sort something out -- but figured I'd check in first to avoid reinventing the wheel if so. Huge thank you to everyone who has contributed so much time and energy to this excellent resource.

Cathleen Balantic
